name: Kaizak von Atlas
original_name: カイザーク・フォン・アトラス
source:
A devil that chases Anduke and his friends like a shadow. A mysterious man who sometimes helps Anduke and his friends, and sometimes accompanies the demons...

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20071215205316fw_/http://www.mink.co.jp/lineup/da/char08.html]Mink[/url]]
